answers.core:
This will be used often because current way of handling it is not intuitive and quite frankly this is something that should already be included from the start. By comparison based on a quick google search:
Game Maker has phy_active, Unity has enabled property on rigidbody, Unreal has collision presets.
Even Blender Allows you to turn off physics yet only in Godot you must handle the simple act of turning collisions on and off per collider.
answers.workaround: It will be used often when user needs to disable the physics on a particular scene.

title: Add a property to disable collision of a PhysicsBody and its children
